brain._max_tokens: How many tokens ONE turn may write, for anyone who is not master - thinking AND chat share this number. Measured on glm-5.3-flash: about 4 characters per token, so a full 2000-character Discord message costs roughly 493 tokens, and reasoning tokens are billed to the same budget. 400 was cutting answers off before they started. 500 is a full reply with a little headroom, and deliberately not more: it is the ceiling on strangers.
brain._owner_max_tokens: Master's ceiling. High on purpose: his replies are capped at 2000 characters by Discord anyway, and a tight cap costs him the answer rather than the money - spend.py never prices his turns. Set it to 0 to omit the field and let the provider decide, which is a literal no-limit.

_stt_ffmpeg: Where ffmpeg lives. LEAVE THIS OUT and whisper_stt looks inside her own folder first - which is where a hand-dropped ffmpeg/ffmpeg.exe belongs, and the only place a binary can live because run-bot.cmd sets no PATH at all. Set it to a bare name like "ffmpeg" only to force an old-style PATH lookup.
